title: Fault injection: malformed articles from a peer
description:
Write a proptest-driven integration test that generates arbitrary byte sequences as IHAVE article bodies and sends them to the transit IHAVE handler. Assert: (1) no panic on any input; (2) malformed articles return 437; (3) the Message-ID to CID map is not modified on rejection; (4) valid articles following a malformed one are still accepted. Artifact: transit/tests/fault_malformed_articles.rs.

Acceptance criteria:
- 500 random inputs tested
- No panics
- Valid articles not affected by prior malformed ones
- Test uses cargo-fuzz corpus if available
